input_note: Both archives were read earlier in this turn. They were no longer present under the workspace when preparing this report, so no archive hashes are claimed.
log_findings: First target failed PING at five seconds over pipe, then PTY reported daemon_unreachable at five seconds. Later targets used native control. The prior stty setup failure did not recur.
Following target 15 authentication timeout, target 16 environment initialization again fell back. This affects newly prepared environments rather than a target index specifically.
Target 1 had four compatibility outcomes explicitly unconfirmed. Restart at 14:07:20 submitted those candidates again.
Other targets explicitly show tried=0, history-skipped=4: history fingerprints are used. A skip is not proof that a password was found.

initialization_fix.before: Send PING immediately after spawning wpa_cli, applying ordinary five-second RPC timeout even before daemon connection and editor startup.
initialization_fix.after: Wait for the real upstream editor prompt on the existing stream in a separate control_ready phase, then perform PING/help/cache/disconnect checks.
initialization_fix.cancellation: Existing bounded cancel/read/channel cleanup used. Startup timeout has a distinct phase and safe reason.
initialization_fix.baseline: Actual upstream 2.10, daemon socket appearing after six seconds, reproduces the old timeout.
initialization_fix.fallback: Unavailable capabilities can still use compatibility; no guarantee that this physical router will be fixed without a new live test.

status.model: Separate password_state/password_note AP fields; captured-file state and selection rules unchanged. No password in these fields.
status.delivery: Typed target lifecycle events update status immediately, including success before popup. Final packed results reconcile status. Cancellation preserves found/completed outcomes and distinguishes untouched targets.
status.rescan: Linear lookup preserves status for matching BSSID+SSID from the current AP snapshot. No independent unbounded cache.
status.persistence_limit: These UI statuses are current-session snapshot data; no new disk-backed task checkpoint. The existing durable fingerprint history remains unchanged.
status.notification: Password completion and cancellation show modeless summary; other task notice behavior unchanged.
status.history_notice: If real candidates remain, report confirmed history skips before the first submitted candidate. A history skip does not imply success.

colors.failed_and_timeout: Existing blocked palette: dark #ef7777 and light #b52d2d
colors.other_active_tasks: Previous password outcome does not recolor active capture/Pin status.

auto_follow.behavior: Set current SSID cell using NoUpdate and scroll to its row; retain existing active-row highlight

validation.debian_native_runtime: Actual native clients against local UNIX socket fixtures; no physical wireless traffic.

sources.source_limit: Exact-release archive was unavailable via official download endpoints with normal TLS verification. Listed upstream sources were read and their actual clients were tested; exact firmware and all-device runtime compatibility are not claimed.
